data.name: Car Sales Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Buy, repair & sell

Buy vehicles from people, auctions, or even garage sales. Whether it's a rusty junker or a hidden gem, bring it back to life through car repair, tuning, and customization, and then sell it for profit. Welcome to the world of smart negotiations and car for sale.

Embark on a journey where the asphalt is your canvas, and every vehicle is a potential masterpiece. In this drag race of deals and thrills, you’re not just a trader, you’re the mastermind behind an automotive empire waiting to be built. As a savvy dealer, you'll scout for the best deals in the region and grow your dealership step by step. Use your instinct to buy low and sell high in this engaging trade simulator. Each ride for sale is a new opportunity to make it big in the world of selling games.

Customize and restore

Every vehicle you touch can become a masterpiece. From full car mechanic jobs to paint, tuning, and detailing - this game brings out the car customizer, builder, and designer in you. Work your way up from basic car mechanic tasks to full restorations, mastering every step of the car repair and upgrade process.

Negotiate like a pro

But building an empire requires more than just slick deals, it’s about alliances and expertise. Forge connections with skilled mechanics, painters, and tuners in the region who will elevate your fleet to new heights. Your negotiation skills are your biggest asset in these car simulator games. Talk to clients, bargain for the best prices, and rise to the top as the go-to name in car dealership business games. But be careful - not every deal is a good one. Outsmart scammers and dominate the trading simulator scene.

Drive and test your builds

Take your freshly tuned cars for a spin! Whether it’s cruising city streets or engaging in drag races, the car simulator and driving sim elements let you feel the thrill of the road as you explore your own drive zone. Realistic car drive mechanics, detailed damage, and handling make it feel like a real driver simulator.

Grow your garage

Your garage is your kingdom - a place to store, fix, and showcase your best builds. Expand it, organize it, and turn it into the ultimate car master collection.

Game features:

  • A massive open region to explore - where every road is a potential race track

  • Rich vehicle trading and shopping mechanics with deep negotiation options

  • Dynamic day & night cycle

  • Immersive driving sim elements that let you test your builds on the road

  • Realistic crash simulator damage physics and driving experience

  • Plenty of customization options - customize vehicles like a true pro

  • Team up with skilled mechanics, painters, and tuners

  • Experience a mix of business games, job simulator, and manager games

If you’re into car 3D, CSR, tuning, or just love buying and selling cool rides, this is the game for you. Build your legacy in the ultimate trade, business, and car simulator experience - all in one. Start building your empire today!
